# Makera postprocessor

`makera_post.py` is the Makera 26.3 Machine postprocessor, distributed under
LGPL-2.1-or-later. Its source is pinned to MakeraInc/CarveraProfiles commit
`de08a657bdc9c230a094dbdba792acd70bfcdf32`.

[Upstream source](https://github.com/MakeraInc/CarveraProfiles/blob/de08a657bdc9c230a094dbdba792acd70bfcdf32/CAM_Post_Processors/Freecad/26PostProcesssor_Machine/makera_26_MCH_post.py)

Trailing whitespace is normalized in this copy. The Z1-specific adapter is in `Resources/Post/makera_z1_bridge_post.py`.
